result:
If I could change just one thing, I think I'd give everyone the ability to *really* feel what it's like to be someone else for a little while — not in a scary mind-reading way, but true empathy.

To actually feel what it's like to be the person you're disagreeing with, or the stranger on the bus, or the kid growing up on the other side of the world. What they're afraid of, what they love, what keeps them up at night.

I think so much of the hurt in the world doesn't come from people being evil, it comes from fear and disconnection. Fear that there won't be enough — enough food, safety, love, respect — so we get defensive, tribal, unkind without even meaning to.

If we could all *get* each other on a gut level, even for a few minutes a day, I think a lot of other problems would become easier to solve together. It's hard to hate, pollute, hoard, or go to war with people you truly understand.

Less "me against you," more "us trying to figure this out together."

What about you? What's your one change?
